races.display_title: Sign Up To GavinLynchRacing.com Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: The level of form BON BON FIZZ has achieved in bumpers since falling on his hurdle debut suggests he should be more than capable of winning a maiden and he can enhance Gordon Elliott's good record in this race. Punchestown runner-up Quest For Answers is second choice ahead of Noel Meade's Downpatrick third Poets Rambler . Henry de Bromhead point recruit Bishop of Rome needs checking out in the betting. BON BON FIZZ (IRE) QUEST FOR ANSWERS (IRE) POETS RAMBLER (IRE)

races.display_title: Christmas Parties At Fairyhouse December 12th Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: A YEAR OLDER was successful on his last run over hurdles returning from 10 months off here on New Year's Day and is chanced to repeat the feat on his reappearance. Moonlight Paradise is another to consider, while it's hard to dismiss the in-form Moonshine Girl for all she faces a much different test than she did when winning at Galway last week. A YEAR OLDER (IRE) MOONLIGHT PARADISE (IRE) MOONSHINE GIRL (IRE)
